about: Two people twenty paces apart. Shot A: extreme wide, low, slow push in, 0 to 3 s. Hard cut. Shot B: over the left one's hip, locked, 3 to 5 s. The left figure stays frame-left in both shots, which holds the 180-degree line.

actors.name: left
actors.role: <the person on the left>, who stays frame-left in every shot

actors.role: <the person on the right>, who stays frame-right in every shot
